selection: Public current boards; gradual accuracy blend across current and two completed years; at most eight. Unfitted selection policy; equal decision votes.

selectionPolicy.basis: Published ranks scaled by largest observed rank per year; partial coverage, missing years use neutral 0.5
selectionPolicy.participation: Leaderboard-level graded weeks; individual participation unavailable
selectionPolicy.votes: One equal vote per analyst; selection score never multiplies votes
